policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Buildings, Contents and Forcible Removal Edition
description: Burglary at the insured home. The back door was forced during the day while the house was empty, and the intruders took clothing and personal effects along with some everyday jewellery. The jewellery was modest - costume and everyday pieces, nothing especially valuable - and the clothing was ordinary wear. The police were called and gave a reference number. A tradesperson re-secured the forced door afterwards. The whole thing was billed as a short couple of summary lines.

lines.1: Replacement of stolen household contents (clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery) | 1 pcs
lines.2: Emergency repair and re-securing of the forced entry door | 1 pcs
